prs.title: Integrate all eight editorial correction batches for combined validation
prs.head: 83d2d95bd0e0ae818428ce6cc8e1bad595b0b9fd
prs.body: Reconciles #509, #510 and #512–#517 against common base 5ebd32f826f75f6c9612841c031bfc8024a72f84. Seven shared files merged with exact replay of each independent source change; remaining files retained byte-for-byte via original blob identities. 40 original changed paths + integration note. Preserve original PRs until combined exact-head validation and protected release verification. Do not merge individual overlapping PRs in parallel. This is 163/163 first-pass editorial coverage, not strict #430 completion; remaining second-pass evidence and human/source/interactive checks are open. No ad activation, account or database changes.

prs.title: Verify review moderation hash privacy with disposable PostgreSQL fixtures
prs.head: 313c034b0e393f21d663e32c957e3a2845098d2d
prs.body: Addresses #519. Stages narrowly scoped privilege SQL and expands existing mandatory review engagement regression to deny anon and authenticated SELECT on moderation hash and wildcard projections, while retaining exact public display fields, likes, hidden/deleted state and service role access. SQL is not yet applied to production; gated database migration and post-change metadata verification follow exact-head CI. No production user records accessed. No advertising or account changes.

prs.title: Second-pass editorial precision and moderation sampling disclosures
prs.head: b39933742f590ae76623ebbe1a6b6f8696e07aec
prs.body: Follow-up to #430 and merged #518. Twelve complete extracted public publisher bodies reviewed skeptically; Privacy extraction truncated and excluded. Eleven narrow copy fixes for unsubstantiated moderation/correction/feedback claims, explicit review sample cap, mobile reliability and definition precision. Includes bounded evidence table; not a claim of full second pass or deployment. No private records accessed, no financial recommendations, no account/ad changes. All normal release gates apply.

prs.head: d4052c46949902664ea06dc2415e6c3167b8680e
prs.body: Supersedes #521 only after fresh CI and verified merge. Carries its 11 edits without overwriting concurrent paths, plus precise review hashing, public duel visibility, leaderboard cap, Daily schedule, local feedback, glossary and article corrections. Coverage ledger lists distinct second-pass extracted bodies, not full editorial closures. No real account data, no ad activation, no new financial recommendations. Exact-head protected validation required.

prs.body: 136 live extracted bodies + 27 source bodies. 19 narrow source/overlay transparency edits; no production course republishing or account changes. prs.title: Produce auditable 163-page source-block hashes without claiming review closure
prs.head: 292b5157407f4f1b154b8d4a1a16478b07888be6
prs.body: Reproducible exact-source publisher block inventory for issue #430. Reads 151 static crawler-visible pages and the 12 already-approved public dynamic-course bodies from dated audit-only snapshot; applies existing display corrections, hashes each block and exports review status NOT_ATTESTED_PER_BLOCK and CSV. Required CI validates inventory and uploads artifact. No customer data, course publication, account or ad changes. This does NOT satisfy full live / media / policy release gates.

prs.body: Supersedes PR #530, which passed all its own exact-head CI and live-sitemap jobs but was blocked by fresh required-status checks after the intervening #529 merge. Source script unchanged between prior main and new base; same narrow audit-only two-file changes transplanted onto current main. Must re-run fresh required workflows; no branch protection bypass, account records or ad changes.

prs.title: Verify native Cloudflare production SHA independently of stricter release-readiness gate
prs.head: c0534e0a01269ee618a39c8045527f47768369c8
prs.body: Main-only, after required validation. Reuses existing read-only exact-SHA Cloudflare Pages verifier with provider secret already referenced in existing release-signals workflow. Does NOT edit/deploy the site, weaken Vercel/recovery gate, alter DNS, touch user data or activate ads. Runs automatically on a protected main push if merged, and fails closed when provider receipt is missing.
